semantics.definition: The rules every Governance role must meet.
semantics.responsibility: Make every role one Cedar permit with two blanks, who and where, granting only actions its own system declares.

system.description: The system whose actions the role grants, as declared in code: mero or governance. A role picks actions from one system.

cedar.description: A Cedar permit template: principal == ?principal, resource in ?resource, and actions the system declares. A grant fills in who and where.
